[[File:Energy Transfer icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Energy Transfer''' is a [[Lunar spell]]. As with all Lunar spells, completion of [[Lunar Diplomacy]] is required to cast this spell. It costs 100% [[special attack]] energy and 10 [[hitpoints]] to cast, and restores all of the target's [[energy|run energy]] and [[special attack]]. The target's [[Accept Aid]] setting must be enabled. If you try to cast it with 10 hitpoints or less you will get the message: {{mes|You need more hitpoints to cast this spell.}} 

This spell is often used with hard/high hitting special attack weapons, such as [[Dragon claws]], to enable the targets to use the special attacks more frequently than they would have been able to do otherwise. However, players cannot cast this spell in [[single-way combat]] PvP areas, or on targets who have recently been in combat on [[PvP world]]s.
